component: libotr source identity and SDK configuration

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The published 5329 coverage observation incorrectly said both owned post blobs match the fixed accepted blobs. The YAML post blob is 13d65f1bbafd63b13f0922958a4413879dc965f6; its fixed blob is ae43656a22498449d789cf729f0145cc9434b08c. The script post blob is e4e237cd11692bf45c9ad1453ce34f5bb8a25f24; its fixed blob is c55e005ff6e365c0ee482e4dc6e392ff36120e26. Only the checked MacOSX26.5.sdk choices and 10.15/11.0 minimum-version values match. The existing SDK-directory versus deployment-minimum lesson remains valid. This corrects identity wording; it does not audit intervening changes, prove a toolchain build or add chronological credit.
title: Correction to 5329: matching libotr SDK values do not mean matching whole-file blobs
